class.name: FilesManifestValidation

members.member: [constant OK] if nothing is missing or unknown. [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND] if [member missing_folders] or [member missing_files] is not empty, otherwise [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] if [member unknown_extensions] is not empty. [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if no manifest is registered under the given name.
The entries of [member FilesManifest.file_paths] that do not exist, as written in the manifest.
The entries of [member FilesManifest.folder_paths] that do not exist, as written in the manifest. [method FilesManifestServer.create_missing_folders] creates them.
The entries of [member FilesManifest.extensions] that no resource loader recognizes. A multi-part extension such as [code].tres.json[/code] is known if its last part is.
